                    20               Plaintiff The National Collection Agency, Inc. (" Plaintiff') withdraws its opposition to
                    21       Claimant Amy McDougall's Claim of Exemption and does not oppose the Claim of Exemption.
                    22               On April 4, 2025, Plaintiff s counsel, Brian B. Miles, spoke with an attorney named
                    23       Jason Koch who stated that he was calling on behalf of Claimant Amy McDougall. (Declaration
                    24       of Brian B. Miles ["Miles Decl."], $ 2). Mr. Miles advised Mr. Koch that Plaintiff was no longer
                    25       opposing the Claim of Exemption and had released its claims to the funds at issue. (Miles Decl.,
                    26       $ 2). Mr. Miles subsequently confirmed this by email to Mr. Koch on April 10, 2025. (Miles
                    27       Decl., Exhibit A).
